title: PAH refinement rate-defect parameter-uniformity boundary
question: Can an absolute generator boundary defect for the named PAH free-vertex route be uniform over the current PAH parameter domain when beta and positive couplings are not transport-bounded?
decision_reason: For two fine states in one coarse fibre, the retained-vertex aperture mobility is the same, while the energy increments differ by the nonzero R-480 defect d=DeltaF_1-DeltaF_2. If either increment is negative, the rate difference contains two distinct exponentials exp(-beta*DeltaF_i/2); as beta tends to infinity, the larger of the two rates diverges and their absolute difference cannot have a beta-uniform finite bound. PAH-001 declares beta>0 and positive couplings but does not declare a compact parameter domain, beta transport, or a normalized defect norm. Therefore no regulator-uniform absolute defect theorem may be admitted from the current bytes alone. The statement is conditional on the existence of an admissible negative increment and is not a global PAH no-go.
method: Use the unchanged displayed PAH rate c_i=m*exp(-beta*DeltaF_i/2) for the retained aperture move.
Substitute the exact R-480 fibre identity DeltaF_1-DeltaF_2=-kappa_s*delta*(z_1-z_2), with positive kappa_s, delta and distinct hidden values.
Apply the elementary exponential asymptotic for a pair of unequal negative increments while keeping the common positive mobility fixed.
Compare the resulting requirement with the PAH-001 parameter domain and PAH-OMC-001 missing-owner list without adding a coupling, counterterm, rate rescaling, carrier or refinement map.
finding: The current source does not supply the hypotheses needed to state a uniform absolute rate-defect estimate: beta and positive couplings are unrestricted, their cross-level transport is absent, and the norm for an approximate intertwining defect is not declared. Under the explicit conditional negative-increment hypothesis, the supremum over beta of the absolute rate defect is infinite. R-480 already proves the unequal-increment premise for the named route. Thus any viable successor must hash-pin either a bounded/transported parameter domain with a signed increment lower bound, or a different normalized defect notion; until then Stage 2 remains HOLD_FOR_EVIDENCE.
decision_scope: Analytic conditional boundary for the composite PAH-001 plus PAH-OMC-001 model and only the named free-vertex forgetful pullback. External stochastic Markov time, finite regulator, no lattice/volume/exhaustion limit. No claim is made about other morphisms or about the existence of a negative increment in every PAH state.
evidence_level: T2 analytic conditional route boundary, using exact R-480 algebra; no physical or continuum evidence
assumptions: The two hidden-fibre energy increments DeltaF_1 and DeltaF_2 are unequal as in R-480.
At least one admissible tested increment is negative, and beta is allowed to vary without an upper bound.
The aperture mobility is common and strictly positive for the two hidden states.
The intended approximate intertwining norm controls an absolute generator/rate defect rather than only a rescaled logarithmic defect.
missing_assumptions: A named beta and coupling parameter transport/domain for every refinement level.
A uniform lower bound or sign rule for the relevant aperture energy increments, or a declared normalized defect norm.
A complete nontrivial coarse map and move/root kernel on which the boundary defect is evaluated.
boundary: This is a conditional obstruction to one kind of uniform absolute defect estimate for one already named pullback. It is not a no-go for bounded-beta transport, a logarithmic/relative defect norm, a different block or conditional kernel, or a separately versioned successor functional.
non_claims: No PAH-001 or PAH-OMC-001 bytes, functional, move set, mobility exponent, projection, regulator or limit order are changed.
No negative increment is asserted for every state or every refinement; it is an explicit hypothesis of this boundary lemma.
No exact or approximate nontrivial refinement is admitted.
No uniform limit, continuum, physical projection, F_lim, F_eff or F_obs is admitted.
No physical Pre-A, spacetime, gravity, event-horizon, QFT, Yang--Mills, mass-gap, cosmic-origin or TOE conclusion follows.

formal_integration.independent: R-480 non-importing algebra supplies the unequal-increment premise
formal_integration.hostile: R-479 hostile suite rejects promotion to global refinement no-go
formal_integration.lean: R479 compiled polynomial nonzero lemma covers the fibre defect
